vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: wdbgp imports only golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt (password hashing). The deprecated openpgp packages this advisory covers are not in the dependency graph of the shipped binary: `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp` reports the main module does not need it, `go list -deps ./cmd/wdbgp` links zero openpgp packages, and govulncheck's symbol-level analysis in CI classifies this advisory as required-but-never-called. The advisory has no fixed version (the package is deprecated, not patched), so upgrading golang.org/x/crypto cannot clear it.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-56854
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/ssh: source-address restriction in returned Permissions not enforced for PasswordCallback/KeyboardInteractiveCallback/NoClientAuthCallback/GSSAPIWithMICConfig.AllowLogin

statements.impact_statement: wdbgp imports only golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt (password hashing) and runs no SSH client or server. The affected package golang.org/x/crypto/ssh is not in the dependency graph of the shipped binary: `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/ssh` reports the main module does not need it, and `go list -deps ./cmd/wdbgp` links zero ssh packages. Fixed in 0.55.0, but wdbgp has no code path capable of exercising this bug regardless of the golang.org/x/crypto version in use.
